*   **Clean up a book's suggested items** (`entity-triage`): Helps you review, merge, or discard AI-suggested story bible items to keep your lore clean.
*   **Set up a book's world categories** (`glossary-bootstrap`): Establishes the foundational categories (like characters, places, or magic systems) that your world will track.
